key_insight: LLMs identify research directions but struggle to turn them into concrete approaches pursued by human research communities.
engineering_relevance: AI research agents need stronger evaluation of concrete methods and research plans, not just literature coverage or proposal presentation.
method: Generate proposals from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025.
Compare citations and ideas with papers published by the same communities in 2026.
Use blinded expert review to assess proposal quality.
evidence_signal: Across six language models, four research areas, and over 90,000 proposals, LLMs reached about 26% of the human citation-matching level and 18% of the human idea-matching level.
watch_item: Matching future publications measures alignment with community choices, not whether unmatched ideas could ultimately prove valuable.
paper_title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
